evaluated_on: frozen unseen test set (2014J cohort, 8,746 students)
notes: The model catches 2,499 of 3,289 at-risk students on a cohort it never saw, against 0.000 recall for the majority-class baseline. It misses 790 at-risk students whose difficulties begin after the prediction point, and raises 1,784 flags on students who turned out fine - the deliberate trade of precision for recall. Decision support only; every flag needs human review.
